scenes.title: Come to the Meeting
scenes.summary: A colleague invites a finance employee to a marketing meeting and takes offense when he politely declines.

scenes.title: Monday Morning Brainstorm
scenes.summary: The colleague admits he wants company for the Monday morning meeting and points out a fire warden trapped inside.

scenes.title: Cintia and the Phone Game
scenes.summary: The colleague warns the employee using Cintia as a dramatic example of someone who skipped a meeting and got stuck waiting.

scenes.title: Aligned and Suddenly Free
scenes.summary: Just as the employee agrees to sit and nod through the meeting, an organizer announces it is canceled and the colleague suggests coffee.

scenes.title: The Chart Made in Canva
scenes.summary: In the closing tag, a presenter walks colleagues through vague charts with good and bad numbers while boasting about his slides.
